title: Exodus Bible Quiz - Chapter 33
description: Ten questions on Exodus 33: God's word that he will not go up among the people, the Tent of Meeting, and Moses' request to see God's glory.

questions.text: Why did God say he would not go up among the people?
questions.explanation: God said he would not go up among them, for they were a stiff-necked people, lest he consume them on the way.

answers.text: The tabernacle was not yet built
The land was too small for them

questions.text: How is the land described in verse 3?
questions.explanation: God told them to go to a land flowing with milk and honey.

questions.text: What did the people stop wearing after they heard this evil news?
questions.explanation: The people mourned, and no one put on his jewelry. They stripped themselves of their jewelry from Mount Horeb onward.

questions.text: Where did Moses pitch the tent he called "The Tent of Meeting"?
questions.explanation: Moses used to pitch the tent outside the camp, far away from the camp, and called it the Tent of Meeting.

answers.text: In the middle of the camp
Outside the camp, far away from it

questions.text: What came down when Moses entered the Tent?
questions.explanation: When Moses entered the Tent, the pillar of cloud descended and stood at the door of the Tent.

questions.text: How did Yahweh speak to Moses?
questions.explanation: Yahweh spoke to Moses face to face, as a man speaks to his friend.

answers.text: Only by the Urim and Thummim
Face to face, as to a friend

questions.text: Who did not depart from the Tent?
questions.explanation: Moses returned to the camp, but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, did not depart from the Tent.

questions.text: What did God promise Moses in verse 14?
questions.explanation: He said: "My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest."

answers.text: He would give Israel a king
He would make Moses very rich
His presence would go with him

questions.text: What did Moses ask God to show him?
questions.explanation: Moses said: "Please show me your glory."

questions.text: Where would God put Moses while his glory passed by?
questions.explanation: God said he would put Moses in a cleft of the rock and cover him with his hand until he had passed by.

answers.text: At the foot of the mountain
In a cleft of the rock
